I analyzed one rollout (seed 5, Valkyrie, model z-ai/glm-5.2) that died on dungeon level 2 after 44 skill calls. The player eventually answered "y" making the guard hostile, re-picked the dropped gold, and was killed by thrown daggers. I created 3 global memories (vault guard mechanics, avoiding explore_level near peaceful NPCs, and answering prompts instead of re-calling skills), 1 prompt note (prioritize descent over exploration), and 1 skill entry (the proven 5-call descent sequence including door-kicking).
